matrix.applied_rule: float64 target formation and one float32 cast; if the original norm gate fails, deterministic bounded scalar bisection within ±0.1% of nominal scale; no tolerance relaxation or fallback
matrix.candidate_rule: average four private AdamW graph updates after ×4 gradient correction
matrix.checkpoint_rule: highest pooled validation accuracy; lowest pooled CE; earliest epoch
matrix.reference_rule: one virtual AdamW moment pair per graph parameter, fed mean full-member gradient on current NORM-SYNC graph weights
matrix.test_rule: complete 12-cell, 96-cell, and 432-cell validation locks before 12 default-cell test scores
matrix.zero_rule: zero reference => zero applied; positive reference with zero candidate => invalid cell; nonfinite => invalid cell
